title: The signed manifest of a Sixkey rules bundle downloaded between releases, schema 1
description: Served at /v1/manifest.json beside the bundle it names (/v1/bundle-<version>.json, live.schema.json). `m` is the manifest itself, a JSON text (the `manifest` definition below) written exactly as JSON.stringify writes its fields in the order of `required`, with no spaces; `kid` is the hex of the first 16 bytes of the SHA-256 of the signing key's SubjectPublicKeyInfo (DER); `sig` is an ECDSA signature with P-256 and SHA-256, written as r and s (IEEE P1363, 64 bytes) in base64url without padding, over the bytes of "sixkey-rules-manifest\n1\n" followed by those of `m`. Sixkey's checker (extension/src/core/rules/signed.ts) also checks what this schema cannot: that `m` is that one text, the signature with a key the build pins and the client has not retired, created at most a day after the client's clock and before expires, expires after the client's clock and at most 180 days after created, a version above the built-in bundle's by 1 to 1,000 and above the last version accepted from the same key, and a bundle of exactly `size` bytes whose SHA-256 is `sha256`, accepted as a live bundle, with the manifest's version, source and licence.
